<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1500 850" width="1500" height="1400" font-family="Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <title>AI agent workflows - Stage 1, 2 and 3</title>
  <defs>
    <style>
      /* ---- Edit colours and fonts here ---- */
      .panel      { fill:#f8fafc; stroke:#e2e8f0; stroke-width:1.5; }
      .panel-title{ font-size:22px; font-weight:700; fill:#0f172a; }
      .node       { fill:#f1f5f9; stroke:#64748b; stroke-width:1.5; }
      .agent      { fill:#dbeafe; stroke:#2563eb; stroke-width:2; }
      .tool       { fill:#ede9fe; stroke:#7c3aed; stroke-width:1.5; }
      .data       { fill:#ffffff; stroke:#64748b; stroke-width:1.5; stroke-dasharray:6 4; }
      .final      { fill:#dcfce7; stroke:#16a34a; stroke-width:2; }
      .label      { font-size:16px; fill:#0f172a; text-anchor:middle; dominant-baseline:central; }
      .sub        { font-size:13px; fill:#475569; text-anchor:middle; dominant-baseline:central; }
      .arrow      { fill:none; stroke:#475569; stroke-width:1.8; marker-end:url(#head); }
      .line       { fill:none; stroke:#475569; stroke-width:1.8; }
    </style>
    <marker id="head" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill="#475569"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>
--------------------------
  <rect width="1500" height="1100" fill="#ffffff"/>
--------------------------------
  <g id="stage1">
    <rect class="panel" x="20" y="20" width="600" height="1050" rx="14"/>
    <text class="panel-title" x="44" y="62">Stage 1 — Agent architecture</text>
    <!-- nodes -->
    <g id="s1-user">
      <rect class="node" x="200" y="100" width="240" height="44" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="320" y="122"> RESEARCHER</text>
    </g>
    <g id="s1-agent">
      <rect class="agent" x="200" y="180" width="240" height="60" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="320" y="201">AI AGENT</text>
      <text class="sub" x="320" y="222">CodeAgent</text>
    </g>
    <g id="s1-tool1">
      <rect class="tool" x="35" y="320" width="170" height="56" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="120" y="339">Parse Paper</text>
      <text class="sub" x="120" y="360">Tool</text>
    </g>
    <g id="s1-tool2">
      <rect class="tool" x="235" y="320" width="170" height="56" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="320" y="339">Calculate</text>
      <text class="sub" x="320" y="360">Tool</text>
    </g>
---------------------------------
    <g id="s1-tool3">
      <rect class="tool" x="435" y="320" width="170" height="56" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="520" y="339">Validate and Verification </text>
      <text class="sub" x="520" y="360"> V&amp;V Tool</text>
    </g>
    <g id="s1-data1">
      <rect class="data" x="35" y="430" width="170" height="96" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="120" y="449">Read Paper(Extract:)</text>
      <text class="sub" x="120" y="470">Key Contributions </text>
      <text class="sub" x="120" y="490">Methodology and  Challenges</text>

      <text class="sub" x="120" y="510">Applications</text>
-----------------------------------------

    </g>
    <g id="s1-data2">
      <rect class="data" x="235" y="430" width="170" height="96" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="320" y="450">Extract equations</text>
      <text class="sub" x="320" y="480">Assumptions mining</text>
      <text class="sub" x="320" y="510">Limitation Analysis</text>
    </g>
--------------------
    <g id="s1-data3">
      <rect class="data" x="435" y="430" width="170" height="96" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="520" y="449">Execute Benchmark</text>
      <text class="sub" x="520" y="480">Compares results</text>
    </g>
    <g id="s1-report">
      <rect class="node" x="200" y="570" width="240" height="44" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="320" y="592">Structured Report</text>
    </g>
    <g id="s1-pdf">
      <rect class="final" x="200" y="660" width="240" height="44" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="320" y="682">PDF</text>
    </g>
    <!-- connectors -->
    <path class="arrow" d="M320 144 V178"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M320 240 V318"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M320 240 V282 H120 V318"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M320 240 V282 H520 V318"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M120 376 V428"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M320 376 V428"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M520 376 V428"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M120 525 V538 H320 V568"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M520 525 V538 H320 V568"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M320 525 V568"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M320 614 V658"/>
  </g>
---------------------------------------------
  <g id="stage2">
    <rect class="panel" x="650" y="20" width="400" height="1050" rx="14"/>
    <text class="panel-title" x="674" y="62">Stage 2 — What I want to develop</text>
    <g id="stage2-n1">
      <rect class="node" x="705" y="100" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="850.0" y="123">Build the Virtual Model</text>
    </g>
    <g id="stage2-n2">
      <rect class="agent" x="705" y="182" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="850.0" y="205">Agent (Build off-line Model)</text>
    </g>
---------------------------------

-------------------------------
    <g id="stage2-n3">
      <rect class="node" x="705" y="264" width="290" height="96" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="850.0" y="287"> Generate VS-code by Python code </text>
      <text class="sub"   x="850.0" y="317"> Run Calculate tool</text>

    </g>

-----------------------------

    <g id="stage2-n4">
      <rect class="node" x="705" y="412" width="290" height="129" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="850.0" y="451">Run computational model in VS</text>

      <text class="sub" x="850.0" y="491">Calls MATLAB /Simulink Model</text>

      <text class="sub" x="850.0" y="519">Generate FEM model</text>
    </g>
-----------------------------

    <g id="stage2-n7">
      <rect class="node" x="705" y="592" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="850.0" y="615">Real Machine Data</text>
    </g>
-----------------
    <g id="stage2-n8">
      <rect class="node" x="705" y="674" width="290" height="96" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="850.0" y="697">Verification</text>
      <text class="sub"   x="850.0" y="717">Measured Vs.Predicted</text>
      <text class="sub"   x="850.0" y="737">Deviation detected</text>


    </g>
------------------------------
    <g id="stage2-n9">
      <rect class="node" x="705" y="806" width="290" height="96" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="850.0" y="819">Human review</text>
      <text class="sub" x="850.0" y="839">investigation causes ( Investigation Agent)</text>
    </g>
-------------------------------
    <g id="stage2-n10">
      <rect class="agent" x="705" y="806" width="290" height="96" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="850.0" y="819">Human review</text>
      <text class="sub" x="850.0" y="849">investigation causes</text>
      <text class="sub" x="850.0" y="869">( Discrepancy Detection Agent)</text>
    </g>

----------------------

    <g id="stage2-n10">
      <rect class="final" x="705" y="946" width="290" height="96" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="850.0" y="976">Update Model</text>

    </g>



    <path class="arrow" d="M850 146 V180"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M850 228 V262"/>
   
    <path class="arrow" d="M850 362 V405"/>

 
    <path class="arrow" d="M850 538 V595"/>

    <path class="arrow" d="M850 638 V672"/>

    <path class="arrow" d="M850 768 V804"/>

    <path class="arrow" d="M850 898 V944"/>
  </g>

-------------------------------------
  <g id="stage3">
    <rect class="panel" x="1080" y="20" width="400" height="1050" rx="14"/>
    <text class="panel-title" x="1104" y="62">Stage 3 — Longer-term vision</text>
    <g id="stage3-n1">
      <rect class="node" x="1135" y="100" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="1280.0" y="123">V&amp;V( check Reliability)</text>
    </g>
    <g id="stage3-n2">
      <rect class="agent" x="1135" y="182" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="1280.0" y="205">AI Agent(V&amp;V)</text>
    </g>
    <g id="stage3-n3">
      <rect class="node" x="1135" y="264" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="1280.0" y="287">Model generation</text>
    </g>
    <g id="stage3-n4">
      <rect class="node" x="1135" y="346" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="1280.0" y="369">Operating Condition</text>
    </g>
    <g id="stage3-n5">
      <rect class="node" x="1135" y="428" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="1280.0" y="451">Experimental measurements</text>
    </g>
    <g id="stage3-n6">
      <rect class="node" x="1135" y="510" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="1280.0" y="533">Continuous Model updating</text>
    </g>
    <g id="stage3-n7">
      <rect class="final" x="1135" y="592" width="290" height="46" rx="8"/>
      <text class="label" x="1280.0" y="615">Validated Digital Twin</text>
    </g>
    <path class="arrow" d="M1280 146 V180"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M1280 228 V262"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M1280 310 V344"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M1280 392 V426"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M1280 474 V508"/>
    <path class="arrow" d="M1280 556 V590"/>
  </g>
</svg>
